subject: 英语
description: 六年级下册英语核心知识点精华总结（小学毕业总复习）

cards.title: 形容词比较级
cards.definition: 两个事物做比较时使用的语法。
core_points: 规则变化：①短词加er: taller, shorter, older, younger ②e结尾加r: nicer, larger
③辅+y变ier: heavier, happier ④双写+er: bigger, thinner, fatter
不规则：good→better, bad→worse, many/much→more
句型：A + is + 比较级 + than + B：Tom is taller than Sam.

example.question: 比较你和你的朋友
steps: My friend is taller than me.
example.answer: My friend is taller than me. But I am heavier than him.

mistakes.wrong: I am more tall than him.
mistakes.correct: 短单词用er不用more: I am taller than him.
He is 10cm taller than me.（数量放在比较级前面）

cards.memory_tip: 📏 比较级=两个比→加er或more; than=比; taller THAN=比...更高

cards.title: 身高体重与度量
cards.definition: 用英语表达身高、体重、鞋码等。
core_points: How tall are you? 你多高？— I'm 1.5 metres / 150 cm.
How heavy are you? 你多重？— I'm 40 kilograms.
How big are your feet? / What size are your shoes? 你穿多大的鞋？— Size 38.
metre米 kilogram千克/公斤 centimetre厘米

mistakes.correct: 超过1要用复数：1.5 metres, 40 kilograms

mistakes.wrong: How long are you?（用错疑问词）
mistakes.correct: 问人的身高用How tall, How long问长度（物体）

cards.memory_tip: 📐 How tall=多高(人), How long=多长(物), How heavy=多重, How big=多大

cards.title: 过去时完整用法
cards.definition: 全面掌握一般过去时的肯定、否定、疑问句。
core_points: 肯定句：I watched TV last night. He went to the park yesterday.
否定句：I didn't watch TV. He didn't go to the park.（didn't + 动词原形）
疑问句：Did you watch TV? Did he go?（Did + 主语 + 动词原形）— Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
was/were的否定：was not=wasn't, were not=weren't; Was he happy? Were they at home?

example.question: What did you do last weekend?
steps: I watched a film and played with friends.
example.answer: I watched a film with my family. Then I played with my friends.

mistakes.wrong: Did you watched TV?（did后还用过去式）
mistakes.correct: Did后用原形：Did you watch TV?

cards.memory_tip: 🎯 did/didn't已经代表过去了，后面动词就不用再变了→回到原形！就像一家只需要一个人出示身份证

related.prerequisite: 见六上 过去时入门

cards.title: 必背不规则动词
cards.definition: 小学阶段必须记住的不规则动词过去式。
core_points: AAA型(不变)：put→put, cut→cut, read→read(发音变)
ABB型(后两同)：buy→bought, bring→brought, think→thought, teach→taught, catch→caught
ABC型(全变)：go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, take→took, give→gave, write→wrote, swim→swam, sing→sang, drink→drank, begin→began, ride→rode, fly→flew, draw→drew, know→knew, grow→grew
特殊：is/am→was, are→were, have/has→had, do/does→did, make→made, come→came, get→got, say→said, run→ran, sleep→slept, tell→told, feel→felt

example.question: yesterday I __(go) to the zoo and __(see) many animals.
example.answer: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw many animals.

mistakes.wrong: 把不规则动词当规则处理：goed,eated
mistakes.correct: went, ate — 没有规律，只能背！
read过去式拼写不变，但发音由/riːd/变为/red/

cards.memory_tip: 📖 分组背：①ew家族：fly-flew, draw-drew, know-knew, grow-grew ②ought家族：buy-bought, bring-brought, think-thought, teach-taught

cards.title: 一般将来时
cards.definition: 表示将来要发生的事或计划。
core_points: be going to + 动词原形：表示计划好的将来
I'm going to visit my grandparents. 我打算探望祖父母。
What are you going to do this summer? 这个暑假你打算做什么？
will + 动词原形：表示临时决定或预测。I will help you. It will be sunny tomorrow.

example.question: What are you going to do in the summer holiday?
steps: I'm going to travel to Beijing and learn to swim.
example.answer: I'm going to travel to Beijing and learn to swim.

mistakes.correct: I AM going to play.（不能忘be动词）

mistakes.wrong: He's going to plays.（going to后加了s）
mistakes.correct: going to后用原形：He's going to play.

cards.memory_tip: 🚀 be going to = 正打算(有计划); will = 将会(临时决定/预测); 两个后面都跟动词原形！

cards.title: 小学英语核心总复习
cards.definition: 回顾小学阶段最重要的英语知识框架。
core_points: 四大时态：①一般现在时(习惯/事实) ②现在进行时(正在做) ③一般过去时(已经做了) ④一般将来时(打算做)
五大句型：①陈述句 ②否定句(not/don't/didn't/won't) ③一般疑问句(Do/Did/Is/Are/Will) ④特殊疑问句(What/Where/When/How/Who/Why) ⑤祈使句(Please.../Don't...)
名词复数：① +s ②es(s/x/sh/ch) ③y→ies ④f→ves ⑤特殊:man-men, child-children, sheep-sheep
最重要的be动词口诀：I用am，you用are，is跟着he/she/it，复数全都用are

example.question: 用四种时态说「我学英语」
steps: 现在: I study English every day.
进行: I am studying English now.
过去: I studied English yesterday.
将来: I am going to study English tomorrow.
example.answer: 四种时态表达同一件事，时间不同用的语法不同。

mistakes.correct: 看时间标志词：every day现在，now进行，yesterday过去，tomorrow将来
What什么 Where哪里 When何时 How怎样 Who谁 Why为什么 Which哪个 Whose谁的

cards.memory_tip: 🎓 小学英语三大基石：①词汇量（背单词）②语法时态（四大时态）③固定搭配（介词/冠词）→ 三根柱子撑起英语大厦！
